title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_lolita_by_vladimir_nabokov_oy1gy (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_lolita_by_vladimir_nabokov_oy1gy' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
